summary: Dominion Energy filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of two series of junior subordinated notes due 2056. The filing is a routine debt capital markets transaction—not a special situation. The registrant is seeking to raise debt capital, with no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change involved. Terms are preliminary, with interest rates and offering amounts to be set. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The offering is a standard shelf takedown; no regulatory clock or risk-arb angle applies.
